# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is a stripped-down copy of the Physical Chemistry Quarto book, ready to use as the starting point for a new book or course compendium. The fonts, callouts, light and dark themes, and output settings are already in place.

Replace this page with your own preface or course description. The title, author, cover, and chapter list live in `_quarto.yml`.

:::learning-goals
- Find the main layout and typography settings.
- Render the book as HTML and EPUB.
:::

:::preparations
Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) 1.9.38 or newer. The extensions and fonts are included in this folder.
:::

:::fact
## A representative equation

For a harmonic oscillator, the vibrational energies are

$$
E_\nu=\hbar\omega\left(\nu+\frac{1}{2}\right),
\qquad
\omega=\sqrt{\frac{k}{\mu}}.
$$
:::
